brief: Implement repo/billing/core.py (classes Engine, BillingError). Public API names are fixed. Implement the FULL spec below; every precedence and interaction detail matters.

work_packages.title: Implement the full billing engine
work_packages.instructions: SPEC. API: Engine(); register_tenant(tenant_id, region='US', loyalty_years=0, is_b2b=False, coupon=None); ingest(tenant_id, request_id, metric, quantity, timestamp); usage_for(tenant_id)->list of event dicts; metered(tenant_id, metric)->int; audit_log (property)->immutable tuple of dicts; issue_invoice(tenant_id)->dict; reconcile(tenant_id)->float. An unregistered tenant defaults to region US, loyalty 0, not b2b, no coupon. INGEST & VALIDATION: metric must be one of {api,storage,egress,compute} else raise BillingError; quantity must be a real int (reject bool and float) and >= 0 else raise BillingError; dedup by (tenant_id,request_id) with FIRST event winning (later same-key = no-op); on each ACCEPTED ingest append {'type':'usage.ingested','tenant_id':...,'request_id':...} to audit_log; usage_for(t) returns only t's events; metered(t,m) sums deduped quantities; tenant-isolated; audit_log is an immutable tuple. PRICING (per metric with metered qty>0; omit zero-usage metrics): tiered with INCLUSIVE boundary (first N units at rate1, remainder at rate2): api first 1000 @0.01 then 0.008; storage first 500 @0.05 then 0.04; egress first 2000 @0.02 then 0.015; compute first 100 @0.10 then 0.08. All money rounds HALF-UP to 2 decimals. Per line: subtotal = tiered price (unrounded); if metered qty >= volume threshold {api:5000,storage:1000,egress:10000,compute:500} multiply subtotal by 0.90 (discount BEFORE rounding); then round half-up -> line amount (never negative). Invoice subtotal = round(sum of the per-line ROUNDED amounts). ACCOUNT DISCOUNTS applied to subtotal in EXACTLY this order then round half-up -> discounted: (1) coupon 'SAVE20' = 20% off if subtotal>=50.00 else ignored (unknown coupon ignored); (2) loyalty = multiply by (1 - min(loyalty_years,5)/100). TAX: rate by region US 0, EU 0.20, UK 0.20, BR 0.17; tax = round(discounted*rate); BUT B2B reverse-charge: if is_b2b AND region in {EU,UK} then tax=0 and invoice reverse_charge=True; total = round(discounted+tax). MINIMUM FLOOR: if NOT reverse_charge and total<5.00 set total=5.00 (reverse-charge exempt). INVOICE dict shape {id, tenant_id, lines:{metric:{qty,amount}}, subtotal, discounted, tax, reverse_charge, total}; issue_invoice idempotent (freeze on first issue, re-issue returns same dict); id='INV-<tenant>-<seq>' seq monotonic per tenant from 1; on issuance append {'type':'invoice.issued','tenant_id':...,'invoice_id':...}. RECONCILE: reconcile(t) = sum over invoice lines of abs(line.qty - metered(t,metric)); 0.0 if no invoice or consistent.
